title.rendered: Download PBA 2k17 Apk + Obb V2.2 For Android

content.rendered:
There is a new update to the PBA 2k17 for Android phone and tablet which is version 2.2 . As you all know, this is a basketball ball  sport game  and you can download it for free.The Philippine Basketball game is packed with many features which I will list below.In the game you select a league to play and take them to the final by playing home and away basketball matches and each match ends in fourth quarter.

When you open the game you can hear some good background music to motivate you while enjoying the game.

You can also reach hall of fame in the PBA 2k17.

If you wish to substitute your players you can do it easily, also check how much your player is worth if you wish to trade him to another team.

What’s New In PBA V2.2

– The user interface has been redesigning.

– Added New Scored Board for better view.

– New Music track was added

– Jerseys have new design

– The control pad is now transparent, better than the old version

– The PBA rooster have being updated to the current one.

– The basketball court has new background colors, banner, and text etc.

How To Install.

– First Install the apk app, don’t open it.

– locate where you saved the data file in your device.

– extract the file com.t2ksport.pba2k17modded into this folder Android/obb/

– After you extract the file open the game in your app menu and play.

Download PBA 2k17 Apk And Game Data

Apk>>> (Size: Approximately 50mb)

Obb>>> (Size: Approximately 900mb)

Installation Video Tutorial

Final Words

The PBA 17 is just like the NBA 2k franchise, with similar features such as commentary, voice instruction and many more, you have just added another basketball game on your device.
